parts.text: Ethane is an alkane which undergoes a photochemical reaction with chlorine as shown. C 2 H 6 (g) + C l 2 (g) → C 2 H 5 C l (l) + HC l (g)

parts.label: e
parts.text: (e) The energy profile diagram of this reaction is shown.

ms.label: 5(e)(iii)
ms.text: energy of products is lower than energy of reactants

parts.label: f
parts.text: (f) The equation for the reaction can be represented as shown. H H C l C l C l + C H H C H H H H C l + C H H C H H Some bond energies are given. bond bond energy / kJ mol C–H 410 C–C 350 C l –C l 240 C–C l 340 H–C l 430 Use the bond energies in the table to calculate the energy change in this reaction. Use the following steps. ● Calculate the energy needed to break bonds. energy = .............................. kJ ● Calculate the energy released in making bonds. energy = .............................. kJ ● Determine the energy change in this reaction. energy change in this reaction = .............................. kJ / mol [3]

ms.label: 5(f)
ms.text:
M1 energy needed to break bonds
6 × C–H + C–C + Cl–Cl = 6 × 410 + 350 + 240 = 3050 (kJ / mol) (1)
M2 energy released in making bonds
5 × C–H + C–C + C–Cl + H–Cl = 5 × 410 + 350 + 340 + 430 = 3170 (kJ / mol) (1)
M3 energy change M1 – M2 = –120 (kJ / mol) (1)
